programme.title: Je le veux
programme.desc: Carly reçoit une demande originale : Gordon, un fan de l'émission, veut demander la main de sa petite amie, Jodi, en direct. Jodi accepte la demande en mariage et convie Carly et ses amis au mariage!

programme.title: Les Blaguo-shirts
programme.desc: Sam et Carly organisent une vente aux enchères avec tout un tas d'objets qui leur ont servi pendant l'émission iCarly. Le t-shirt rigolo remporte un succès.

programme.title: Le roi de la blague
programme.desc: Carly n'a jamais fait de blague et demande à Spencer de l'aider. Il fini par accepter, mais ses vieux démons le rattrapent. Lorsqu'il était en troisième, on l'appelait le roi de la blague, jusqu'au jour où.

programme.title: Sam et sa mère
programme.desc: Freddie filme un vol au Groovy Smoothie, permettant d'identifier le criminel. Mais les journalistes révèlent le nom et l'adresse du jeune garçon en direct.

programme.title: Pitié pour Nevel!
programme.desc: Nevel, l'ennemi numéro un de iCarly vient de se ridiculiser sur le net en criant sur une petite fille dans un supermarché... Désormais tout le monde le déteste, pour la plus grande joie de la bande d'iCarly.

programme.title: Le stagiaire
programme.desc: L'émission a de plus en plus de succès et le groupe a donc de plus en plus de travail. Ils décident d'engager un stagiaire pour les aider.

programme.title: lance la guerre des fans
programme.desc: L'équipe d'iCarly va enfin pouvoir assister au Webicône cette année, ils vont même y faire une grande Conférence questions-réponses pour échanger avec leurs fans...

programme.title: lance la guerre des fans
programme.desc: L'équipe d'iCarly va enfin pouvoir assister au Webicône cette année, ils vont même y faire une grande Conférence questions-réponses pour échanger avec leurs fans...

programme.title: Révélation
programme.desc: Brad devient le nouveau stagiaire de l'émission. Freddie et lui créent une application pour Pear Pad : le testeur d'humeur. Freddie l'utilise sur Sam et découvre qu'elle est amoureuse.

programme.title: En couple avec Sam et Freddie
programme.desc: Sam et Freddie sortent ensemble pour la plus grande joie de Carly qui est ravie de voir ses deux amis amoureux après s'être détestés toutes ces années.

programme.title: En couple avec Sam et Freddie
programme.desc: Sam et Freddie sortent ensemble pour la plus grande joie de Carly qui est ravie de voir ses deux amis amoureux après s'être détestés toutes ces années.

programme.title: Insupportable!
programme.desc: La relation entre Sam et Freddie commence à peser sur tout le monde ! Gibby devient le souffre-douleur attitré de Sam, Carly se fait évincer de la caméra, et aussi des sorties avec ses amies.

programme.title: Je taime
programme.desc: Carly suggère à Freddie et Sam de passer plus de temps ensemble et d'apprendre à se connaître. Sam ira donc jouer au petit train avec Freddie et ses copains et Freddie accompagnera Sam visiter son oncle et son cousin en prison. Mais c'est un échec.

programme.title: Lintello
programme.desc: Carly rencontre Kyle, un garçon très intelligent. Pour ne pas paraître stupide à ses yeux, elle étudie et fait des recherches sur Internet avant leur rendez-vous.

programme.title: rencontre la Première Dame des États-Unis
programme.desc: Carly se réjouit de revoir son père qui rentre fêter son anniversaire avec elle et Spencer. Malheureusement, la jeune fille déchante très vite quand elle apprend que son père ne pourra finalement pas rentrer.

programme.title: Les Z'intrus
programme.desc: Un ado réalise sa destinée en menant frère, sœur et cousins dans une bataille contre des extraterrestres qui utilisent leur maison de vacances pour planifier une invasion.

programme.title: Aladin et la lampe magique
programme.desc: A l'aide d'une lampe magique, un jeune homme pauvre se transforme en prince afin de conquérir le cœur d'une belle princesse.

programme.title: Blue, mon chien d'Australie
programme.desc: Une histoire australienne emblématique de la famille, de l'amitié et de l'aventure, entre un jeune garçon et un chien rustique unique en son genre qui deviendra une légende australienne.

programme.title: Urban Country
programme.desc: Une adolescente de la ville décide d'aller passer l'été au ranch familial dans une petite ville du sud pour s'occuper de sa mère malade.

programme.title: Foster
programme.desc: Un couple qui n'arrive pas à avoir d'enfants décide d'adopter. Ils se rendent dans un orphelinat mais la procédure est longue. Alors qu'ils se découragent, un petit garçon de 7 ans se présente chez eux.

programme.title: Dahmer le Cannibale
programme.desc: Inspiré d'une histoire vraie, Dahmer raconte l'histoire du célèbre serial-killer Jeffrey Dahmer.

programme.title: Ip Man : L'Éveil du maître
programme.desc: Lors d'une visite à Hong Kong, le jeune Maître Ip intervient dans une tentative d'enlèvement, déclenchant sans le vouloir une guerre au sein d'un impitoyable réseau de trafic d'êtres humains. En représailles, le gang kidnappe l'un des amis proches d'Ip Man, qui n'a d'autre choix que de se mesurer au champion de boxe notoirement brutal du groupe.

programme.title: Alana : Déesse de Justice
programme.desc: Séparée de ses parents à la naissance suite à une éruption volcanique, puis ayant grandi dans une société très injuste, Alana tente de comprendre le mystère de ses crises de colère. Quand elle apprend qu'elle est la réincarnation de Sri Asih, la déesse de justice, elle va mettre ses super-pouvoirs au service du bien contre la corruption et le crime organisé.

programme.title: Légitime Vengeance
programme.desc: Ancien membre des forces spéciales, Jack Johnson décide de se faire vengeance lui-même après l'assassinat de sa femme enceinte sur leur propriété. Ses actions déclenchent une guerre brutale contre la famille d'un caïd local, menant à un affrontement explosif.

programme.title: Kidnapping Mr. Heineken
programme.desc: En 1983, Henry Heineken, petit-fils du fondateur de la marque, est kidnappé avec son chauffeur. Les ravisseurs demandent une rançon record de 35 millions de florins.

programme.title: Baron rouge
programme.desc: Allemagne, Première Guerre mondiale : le célèbre pilote Manfred von Richthofen, alias Le Baron Rouge, tombe amoureux de Käte et réalise que son image sert la propagande.

programme.title: Criminal Activities
programme.desc: Quatre amis investissent ensemble de grosses sommes. Mais les affaires tournent mal et la mafia est bientôt à leurs trousses…

programme.title: Avocat (L')
programme.desc: Jeune avocat prometteur, Léo, fraîchement reçu au barreau, attire des clients prestigieux grâce à son talent pour le droit des affaires.

programme.title: Elikia
programme.desc: Elikia, l'histoire d'un jeune homme accablé par son quotidien désastreux qui décide de se lancer dans la danse suite à sa rencontre avec Gabrielle.

programme.title: Levittown
programme.desc: Un jeune homme traverse le quartier résidentiel de Levittown, première banlieue américaine, animé par un monologue aux répliques familières. Non loin de là et alors que le soleil se couche, une jeune femme est confrontée à une menace invisible.

programme.title: Mon Oncle
programme.desc: Un jeune garçon passe ses vacances d'été chez sa grand-mère. Chaque matin marque le début d'une longue attente jusqu'au soir lorsque son oncle rentre du travail et lui raconte sa journée. Il faut dire que tonton n'a pas un métier comme les autres. Il est cascadeur pour la télé...

programme.title: Gangster backstage
programme.desc: A l'occasion d'un casting en Afrique du Sud, Teboho Edkins a demandé à des gangsters de mettre en scène leur propre image.

programme.title: La nuit des jours
programme.desc: Mariée à un cosmonaute alcoolique, grosse et poilue, Tzutza est une étoile qui se réveille chaque jour pour briller!

programme.title: Sur la route du paradis
programme.desc: Leila et ses deux enfants, Sarah et Bilal, ont quitté leur terre natale afin de s'installer en France. Sans papiers, et à la recherche de son mari réfugié en Angleterre, Leila, qui souhaite offrir à ses enfants une vie meilleure, tente de survivre et de les élever dans la clandestinité. Alors qu'elle retrouve enfin la trace de son époux et dispose de l'argent nécessaire, l'étau se resserre.

programme.title: La vie sans truc
programme.desc: Popolo, le plus grand magicien du monde ! Tu parles ! Il vient de paumer les jambes d'Amabilé, sa sublime assistante, dans le numéro de la femme coupée en deux ! Pour la consoler, il lui a promis de lui payer des vacances à la mer. C'est bien beau ! Mais maintenant qu'il est sans boulot, va falloir qu'il aille faire le guignol au Paul Emploie, comme tout le monde !

programme.title: Benidorm
programme.desc: Dans une station balnéaire vivent une jeune mère et sa fille. L'une vit la nuit, l'autre le jour. Elles ne se croisent jamais et le seul lien qui leur permet de maintenir un semblant de vie commune est un talkie-walkie.

programme.title: Cache-Cash
programme.desc: Jacques, 58 ans, a fait un AVC. À son réveil à l'hôpital, deux hommes se tiennent à son chevet. Ils prétendent être ses amis de longue date, avoir braqué un bar-tabac avec lui, et être là pour récupérer leur part du butin. Selon eux, Jacques est le seul à savoir où se trouve l'argent. Seulement, Jacques ne se souvient plus de rien. Jacques bluffe-t-il ? Ces deux hommes sont- ils vraiment ses amis ?

programme.title: Bad Gones
programme.desc: Matteo, neuf ans, rêve d'assister à un match de foot de son équipe fétiche : l'Olympique Lyonnais. Son père décide de l'emmener au stade de Gerland, mais le prix des places est au dessus de ses moyens. Le père ne peut pas acheter les billets. Comment va-t-il faire face à cette humiliation ?

programme.title: L'Amour du risque
programme.desc: Lila est coach love. Elle anime un séminaire sur l'amour et la séduction pour jeunes hommes en grande souffrance au Bois de Boulogne. Mais un jour, voilà qu'elle voit débarquer son ex.

programme.title: On ira à Neuilly Inch'Allah
programme.desc: C'est l'histoire d'une manifestation de jeunes travailleurs de Vélib', qui apprennent la lutte et tentent de s'organiser. C'est l'histoire d'une joute entre l'image et le son.

programme.title: Boobzilla change de pneus
programme.desc: Leyomi Bum Bum, ancienne championne de tuning, filme le tutoriel de son dernier projet: Boobzilla.

programme.title: Giggino ‘o bello
programme.desc: Un vieux criminel, Nonno, se cache dans une cave avec Giggino son petit-fils.

programme.title: L'étrange disparition de M. Walter Werner
programme.desc: Où est donc passé Walter ? Alban semble être le seul à s'interroger.

programme.title: Entre chien et loup
programme.desc: Sohrab, un jeune soldat enrôlé dans l'armée, se retrouve face à ses congénères lors d'une manifestation.

programme.title: Le grand jeu
programme.desc: Mathias et Alex ont rendez-vous à l'aube sur un petit parking en pleine campagne. Ils se connaissent bien mais tout semble les opposer. Pourtant, un secret les unit. Cette année encore, rien ne pourra les détourner de ce qu'ils sont venus accomplir. Que nous révèlera leur entreprise mystérieuse et fantasque ?

programme.title: Je suis l'ombre d'une flamme
programme.desc: Un couple préhistorique tente d'allumer un feu...

programme.title: Peine perdue
programme.desc: Une fin d'après-midi au bord d'une rivière, un concert près de l'eau. L'étrange Rodolphe remarque Alex, jeune homme timide qui n'a d'yeux que pour Julia, parisienne en vacances. Rodolphe entreprend de l'aider, à sa manière...

programme.title: Nous sommes tous des êtres penchés
programme.desc: Nous sommes tous des êtres penchés. C'est notre manière pour nous tenir debout. Deux combats, deux époques, pour une même soif de reconnaissance, sur deux histoires qui ne finissent pas de ricocher l'une sur l'autre.

programme.title: American Ninja 5
programme.desc: Lorsque la fille d'un scientifique est kidnappée, American Ninja (David Bradley) tente de la retrouver, mais cette fois-ci, il fait équipe avec un jeune qu'il a formé aux techniques du ninja.

programme.title: The eXtremists
programme.desc: Une équipe de tournage se rend dans les Alpes autrichiennes, près de l'ancienne frontière yougoslave, pour filmer trois passionnés de sports extrêmes poursuivis par une avalanche pour une publicité. Ce qu'ils ignorent, c'est qu'ils tournent à proximité de la cachette secrète de Slobodan Pavle, un criminel de guerre serbe. L'ayant accidentellement filmé, ils se retrouvent entraînés dans une course-poursuite mortelle à travers les montagnes, mêlant ski, snowboard, parachutisme, rafting, hélicoptères, motos et base jump.

programme.title: The Agent
programme.desc: Jong-seong, un agent fantôme nord-coréen, interrompt une vente d'armes illégale à Berlin. Un agent nord-coréen notoire met à l'épreuve la loyauté de tous les participants alors que Jong-seong se prépare à faire le sacrifice ultime.

programme.title: L'Affaire CIA
programme.desc: Un ancien employé de CIA découvre un complot mortel tout en essayant de sauver sa fille qui a été enlevée.

programme.title: Poisson D'avril
programme.desc: Emile, un mécanicien apprécié mais un brin naïf, se laisse convaincre par un vendeur insistant et lui achète un attirail de pêche. Préférant cacher cette dépense déraisonnable à sa femme, Emile s'éclipse pour tester le matériel chez une cousine, Annette. Une série de quiproquos improbables les obligent à prétendre que tous deux forment un couple.

programme.title: Ratchet Et Clank
programme.desc: Ratchet et Clank unissent leur force, intelligence et courage pour lutter contre le maléfique Drek qui veut détruire la galaxie. Avec l'aide des Rangers Galactiques ils vont se lancer dans une aventure spectaculaire ! Ce duo de choc est basé sur la franchise des jeux vidéo Ratchet & Clank de Sony, qui a été écoulée à plus de 13 millions d'exemplaires à travers le monde.

programme.title: J'aurais Voulu Etre Un Danseur
programme.desc: François mène une vie paisible et heureuse avec sa ravissante épouse et son jeune fils jusquà ce qu'il découvre pour la première fois la comédie musicale "Singin' in the rain". Hypnotisé, il quitte sa famille pour se consacrer à sa nouvelle et dévorante passion pour les claquettes. Mais il ne sait pas encore que son père et son grand-père ont fait la même chose des années auparavant...

programme.title: Monsieur Lazhar
programme.desc: À Montréal, une enseignante du primaire meurt subitement. Bachir Lazhar, un immigrant algérien, est rapidement embauché pour la remplacer alors qu'il nage lui-même en pleine tragédie personnelle. Il apprend peu à peu à connaître un groupe d'enfants attachants, malgré le fossé culturel qui se manifeste dès la première leçon. Pendant que la classe amorce un processus de guérison, personne à l'école ne soupçonne le passé douloureux de Bachir, qui risque l'expulsion du pays à tout moment. Adapté d'une pièce de théâtre d'Evelyne de la Chenelière, Monsieur Lazhar met en images la rencontre de deux mondes et la puissance de la parole. Philippe Falardeau y suit avec humour et sensibilité un homme humble prêt à transcender sa propre perte pour aider les écoliers à vaincre le silence qui les emmure.

programme.title: Harvey Milk
programme.desc: Le film retrace les huit dernières années de la vie d'Harvey Milk. Dans les années 70, il fut le premier homme politique américain ouvertement gay à être élu à des fonctions officielles, à San Francisco en Californie ...

programme.title: Inheritance
programme.desc: À la mort de sa mère, Maya retrouve son père à New York. Celui-ci l'emmène au Caire, où il est alors enlevé.

programme.title: The Best Offer
programme.desc: Virgil Oldman, un expert en art reclus, acquiert des tableaux inestimables en trompant leurs propriétaires sur leur valeur. Engagé par la mystérieuse Claire Ibbetson pour évaluer son patrimoine, Virgil découvre des pièces mécaniques et demande l'aide de son ami Robert pour les réassembler.

programme.title: Avoir et à tenir
programme.desc: Après être tombée amoureuse de Joe, un jeune homme riche , Alice apprend qu'il est loin d'être parfait.

programme.title: L'Amour sous le citronnier
programme.desc: Licenciée, la photographe Becka tente un concours à Serenity Island. Elle y aide Josh, un fermier réticent.

programme.title: Coup de foudre au manoir
programme.desc: Isabella et Blake organisent une fête au manoir, ignorant les surprises qui les attendent.

programme.title: Aviator
programme.desc: Un biopic illustrant les premières années de la carrière légendaire du réalisateur et aviateur Howard Hughes, de la fin des années 1920 au milieu des années 1940.

programme.title: Le complexe du castor
programme.desc: Cadre au travail, un mari en difficulté adopte une marionnette de castor comme seul moyen de communication.

programme.title: Last Chance Harvey
programme.desc: Un auteur de slogans dépassé (Dustin Hoffman) et une bureaucrate anglaise solitaire (Emma Thompson) se rencontrent par hasard et transforment la vie l'un de l'autre.

programme.title: Staying Alive
programme.desc: Cela fait cinq ans que le Staying Alive de Tony Manero fait toujours autant fureur. Il se approche maintenant nonchalamment de son plus grand défi : le produire sur la scène de Broadway.

programme.title: Permanent Midnight
programme.desc: Le film raconte l'ascension de Jerry Stahl, d'un petit scénariste de télévision à un humoriste à succès. Au cours du film, Stahl se bat contre sa dépendance à la drogue, ce qui lui fait rater de nombreux emplois.

programme.title: Blessures secrètes
programme.desc: Une histoire déchirante sur le passage à la vie adulte d'un garçon au beau-père tyrannique et violent et à la mère émotionnellement instable.

programme.title: Le 12ème Homme
programme.desc: Durant la Seconde Guerre mondiale, douze membres de la Résistance embarquent à bord d'un bateau de pêche pour saboter des installations militaires allemandes en mer du Nord. Tous sont capturés et torturés, sauf l'un d'entre eux qui réussit à s'échapper.

programme.title: Crypto
programme.desc: Un jeune banquier de Wall Street, rétrogradé dans sa ville natale, découvre un réseau de corruption.

programme.title: Bad Samaritan
programme.desc: Deux voleurs découvrent un sombre secret en cambriolant une maison et doivent affronter un tueur redoutable.

programme.title: Rememory
programme.desc: La mort suspecte de Gordon, créateur de la machine Rememory, lance une enquête pour percer le mystère.

programme.title: Close Up
programme.desc: La carrière, la vie privée, la filmographie et les secrets de vos stars hollywoodiennes préférées.

programme.title: Close Up
programme.desc: La carrière, la vie privée, la filmographie et les secrets de vos stars hollywoodiennes préférées.

programme.title: Ultimate Countdown
programme.desc: Les moments les plus mémorables du cinéma et des célébrités sont classés dans cette émission captivante.

programme.title: L'amour d'une mère
programme.desc: Mariée et mère de famille, Laney mène en apparence une vie paisible. Mais c'est sans compter sur la drogue, les rencontres avec d'autres hommes et son habitude de disparaitre sans prévenir.

programme.title: Comment Savoir
programme.desc: Lisa ne vivait que pour sa passion du sport et du softball, mais sa soudaine exclusion de son club la laisse complètement désemparée. C'est alors qu'elle fait la connaissance de Matty, un joueur de baseball professionnel, séducteur invétéré plutôt nombriliste...

programme.title: From Prada to Nada
programme.desc: Nora et Mary Dominguez, deux soeurs gâtées, mènent une vie dorée à Beverly Hills. Cependant leur monde s'écroule quand leur père meurt subitement. Maintenant sans le moindre sou, elles doivent vivre chez leur tante Aurelia à Los Angeles.

programme.title: Blue State
programme.desc: Dans cette charmante comédie romantique, un fervent libéral (Breckin Meyer), après la défaite de son candidat aux élection, tient sa promesse de partir au Canada et rencontre en chemin une jeune femme aussi sexy que mystérieuse (Anna Paquin).

programme.title: Un Noël de Roman
programme.desc: La romancière cynique Dru Cassadine, connue pour ses histoires d'amour, cherche désespérément à percer après une série d'échecs. Poussée par des critiques brutales et la menace de son éditeur de la laisser tomber, elle n'a que quelques semaines pour écrire un best-seller.

programme.title: La Plus Belle Étoile de Noël
programme.desc: Une médecin rentre chez elle pour Noël et découvre que son père a décidé de prendre sa retraite. Après avoir retrouvé son amour de lycée, elle se demande si elle doit rester et reprendre le cabinet de son père.

programme.title: L'envie
programme.desc: Deux voisins, également très bons amis, voient leurs relations se détériorer, lorsque l'un d'entre eux devient riche en commercialisant son invention. L'autre va alors envier sa fortune.

programme.title: La montagne du silence
programme.desc: Les deux amies Johanna et Marlies sont spécialisées dans la conception de campagnes de marketing au sein de l'Association autrichienne du tourisme. Lorsqu'on a demandé à Johanna de commercialiser une région montagneuse isolée de Styrie en tant que nouvelle "destination de plaisir", son enthousiasme était limité. La citadine invétérée ne peut rien faire avec les montagnes, les fermes et les cloches qui sonnent. Son amie et collègue Marlies, en revanche, aime les montagnes par-dessus tout et est donc en feu lorsqu'elle se voit attribuer le contrat pour le projet sur la recommandation de Johanna. Elle parvient même à convaincre l'alpiniste de renommée mondiale Ferdinand Plocher de participer à la campagne - et elle s'intéresse aussi personnellement à ce charmant homme de plein air. Tout semble être parfait : Johanna peut rester à Vienne pendant que les Marlies, pleines de vie, se baladent dans les montagnes pour faire des recherches. Jusqu'à ce que Johanna reçoive la nouvelle choquante de la mort de son ami. Stupéfaite et accablée par un profond sentiment de culpabilité, elle se rend en Styrie pour ramener le corps de Marlies à la maison. Elle y retrouve Ferdinand, qui avait flirté sans retenue avec elle lors de sa visite à Vienne, mais qui se retrouve soudain à l'écart. Comme Marlies auparavant, Johanna loue une chambre d'hôte sur l'Almhof au frère de Ferdinand, Jörg, un solitaire amer qui doit s'occuper seul de sa fille malade Veverl. Les querelles constantes entre les frères différents rendent Johanna méfiante. D'autres éléments indiquent également que l'accident d'escalade de Marlies s'est produit différemment de ce qui avait été annoncé. Bien qu'elle rencontre un mur de silence parmi les villageois, elle continue à faire des recherches inlassables. Et même si Ferdinand ne l'aide pas vraiment, les deux se rapprochent émotionnellement. Plus Johanna passe de temps avec l'alpiniste passionné, plus elle apprend à apprécier les montagnes majestueuses et impressionnantes. Elle commence alors à tomber amoureuse de l'homme qui semble le mieux connaître les véritables circonstances de la mort de son amie.

programme.title: Les Babysitters
programme.desc: À 17 ans, Shirley Lyner, lycéenne, pense à l'université et gère un service de baby-sitting qui fournit des call-girls adolescentes aux pères de jeunes enfants. Dans un long flashback, nous voyons ce qui l'a amenée à passer du statut de baby-sitter à celui d'organisatrice et de gérante du service. Tout commence avec Michael, le père des enfants dont elle s'occupe. Une tasse de café sur le chemin du retour, une visite nocturne dans une gare de triage, et les choses s'enchaînent. Shirley peut se montrer impitoyable, et la tension monte lorsque certains clients emmènent les filles dans un chalet à la montagne et apportent de la drogue. Puis, l'une des filles tente de se mettre à son compte. Cela peut-il bien se terminer : est-ce une tragédie en devenir ? Avons-nous tous des secrets ?

programme.title: Darkweb
programme.desc: Un couple de vidéastes organise des parties de chasse pour les millionnaires en quête de sensations fortes.

programme.title: Oxygen
programme.desc: Deux gars kidnappent la femme d'un homme riche et l'enterrent dans une boîte avec 24 heures d'oxygène.

programme.title: Lizzie
programme.desc: Une adaptation de l'histoire de Lizzie Borden, accusée du double meurtre de son père et de sa belle-mère.

programme.title: Le Casse-Coeur
programme.desc: En plein cambriolage dans une maison, harry rencontre daisy et décide de la sauver d'elle-même.

programme.title: Darkweb
programme.desc: Un couple de vidéastes organise des parties de chasse pour les millionnaires en quête de sensations fortes.

programme.title: Holmes and Watson
programme.desc: Une version humoristique des enquêtes classiques de Sir Arthur Conan Doyle mettant en vedette Sherlock Holmes et le docteur Watson.

programme.title: Dick

programme.title: Poorna Bell On How To Put Yourself First
programme.desc: Award-winning journalist and author Poorna Bell joins Fearne to talk about ageing, ambition, marriage, motherhood, grief and the quiet rage that can build when women feel invisible. From challenging the narrative that women "disappear" in midlife, to questioning the myth of "having it all", this conversation is about reclaiming agency, on your own terms.

programme.title: Liz Earle On Her Perimenopause And Midlife Reinvention
programme.desc: Broadcaster and healthy ageing expert Liz Earle discusses her transformation from overwhelmed, overweight, and exhausted during perimenopause to thriving in her 60s. She shares the lifestyle shifts that improved her health, including the importance of morning light and circadian rhythms, strength training, sleep, and consistency in wellbeing.

programme.title: Ruby Wax On Why Trump Scares Her!
programme.desc: Have you noticed that your memory and rational thinking disappear when you're anxious? Ruby Wax wants you to retrain your focus and attention in a digital world that's always trying to steal it. In this chat with Fearne – live from the Happy Place Festival – Ruby explains the difference between mental health and mental illness, and why she calls meditation 'mind gym'.

programme.title: Dr Julie on Triggers And Behaviour Patterns
programme.desc: Psychologist Dr Julie Smith discusses why criticism hurts so deeply, explaining how your brain needs evidence rather than mantras to build self-worth and change your critical inner voice. She explores why feedback from others can trigger old wounds and how patterns developed in childhood keep replaying in adulthood.

programme.title: Ruth Langsford On Coping With Grief & Loss
programme.desc: Broadcaster Ruth Langsford opens up about navigating divorce, grief, and the emotional reality of caring for parents with dementia. From therapy breakthroughs to the power of female friendships, Ruth shares the tools that have helped her find strength in life's most difficult moments. Fearne and Ruth compare their experiences of mum guilt, and why it's so important for young boys in particular to see the women in their life working. Ruth also reveals the sliding doors moment that led her to her TV presenting career. Content warning: this episode contains conversations about grief after suicide.

programme.title: Keir Starmer's Weirdest Moments As Prime Minister
programme.desc: Keir Starmer's time in office has come to a close. His legacy includes some strange moments. From meeps to releasing sausages to going footy mad, relive all of the best and worst moments from the last two years. Hear clashes with Rishi Sunak and Kemi Badenoch, awkward encounters with Donald Trump, and gaffes at various major summits.

programme.title: I Was Diagnosed With HIV At 17
programme.desc: Adrian Duggan was diagnosed with HIV at the age of 17 after going to the doctor for an STI test. Now 23, Adrian is a part of the 'You, Me and HIV' campaign. Launched in January of 2025, the campaign aims to tackle misconceptions surrounding a HIV diagnosis in order to help reduce the stigma experienced by people living with HIV across Ireland.

programme.title: FootballJOE Quiz
programme.desc: The FootballJOE Quiz returns for its 100th episode with original panelists Ben and Ibi. The episode focuses on century milestones with questions about goals, caps, and appearances, alongside new quiz rounds.

programme.title: JOE Pub Quiz with TommyInnit and Max Fosh
programme.desc: TommyInnit and Max Fosh go head-to-head in the Joe Pub Quiz with a YouTube twist, battling it out across rounds testing their knowledge of the platform, iconic YouTube moments and some of the biggest names in internet history. From guessing who said which iconic line, to throwback YouTube apologies from Logan Paul, classic Sidemen diss tracks and a final rapid-fire round where they have to identify famous YouTubers from photos. Along the way, Tommy and Max also get into some of the biggest debates in YouTube history, including whether we need to bring proper YouTube apologies back, the golden era of diss tracks and what KSI leaving the Sidemen means for them.

programme.title: When Did Elon Musk Lose His Mind?
programme.desc: When did Elon Musk make the jump from salesman to supervillain? Quinn Slobodian and Ben Tarnoff trace Musk's journey from tech billionaire to stalwart of the online right. From his upbringing in apartheid South Africa to the rise of Tesla and SpaceX, they detail his changing views on AI and the "woke mind virus", as well as his eventual alliance with Donald Trump. Slobodian and Tarnoff examine his industrial philosophy, what led him to the White House, his purchase of Twitter, and his various attempts to further fuse technology into our lives.

programme.title: Joe Pub Quiz with Eddie Hall & Expressions
programme.desc: Eddie Hall and Expressions take on a quiz about the Sidemen, Gen Z slang, old-school phrases, and iconic Sidemen quotes. From completely missing the mark to unexpectedly clutch answers, the episode is full of laughs as they attempt to decode Gen Z slang, test how well they know each other, and recall legendary Sidemen moments.

programme.title: Labour's Local Election Wipeout Analysed
programme.desc: Laura and Seán analyse the 2026 local elections, examining the winners and losers as Labour's poor form continues. Reform achieved significant gains with a landslide in councils across the country, whilst the Greens made notable wins in Hackney and Edinburgh. In Wales, Labour's First Minister failed to gain reelection as the party's troubles deepen. The question remains whether Keir Starmer can survive.

programme.title: On The Ground At Tommy Robinson's Unite The Kingdom rally
programme.desc: Around 60,000 people gathered at Parliament Square on 16 May for Tommy Robinson's Unite The Kingdom rally, ostensibly to defend freedom, protect children, and take the country back. It was the smaller of two protests in central London, with at least a quarter of a million attending a pro-Palestine rally commemorating the 78th anniversary of the Nakba and uniting against the far-right. On the rally's main stage, a man covered in bacon played the cello.

programme.title: AI CEOs Being Absolutely Insane
programme.desc: Have you ever paid attention to the voices behind the 'inevitable' AI revolution? OpenAI's Sam Altman, SpaceX's Elon Musk, and Palantir's Alex Karp are among the tech elite. They're building the models they claim will change work, politics, and life forever. But when they talk about this future, their rhetoric ranges from bizarre to sinister. From Musk's prediction that there's "a 10 to 20% chance of killer robots wiping out humanity" to Altman's sale of intelligence as utility, things look pretty bleak.

programme.title: Glen Powell Takes The Irish Test
programme.desc: Glen Powell and Edgar Wright are put to the test to see if they can earn themselves an honourary Irish passport. To do so, they must pass a series of tests to prove their Irishness. Do they know what a spicebag is? Can they tell the difference between real and fake Irish sayings? And can they identify some iconic Irish people?

programme.title: Taylor Lorenz Interview
programme.desc: Taylor Lorenz is the journalist mapping out the culture of the internet and everything surrounding it. She discusses the growing power of the right in the online world, their ever-tightening grip on regulations of the internet and speech in the digital space, and how to fight back against it.

programme.title: Why Politics Doesn't Work Anymore
programme.desc: Author and Academic Anton Jäger discusses his book Hyperpolitics, examining contemporary political participation and the challenges facing progressive movements. He explores the decline of traditional party politics, the shift towards hyperpolitics where people are engaged but unorganised, and why the right has been more successful in building institutions. Jäger outlines issues with social media activism and presents approaches to creating a more collectivised political movement capable of challenging right-wing advances.

programme.title: Palantir: The UK Government's Single Point Of Failure
programme.desc: Martin Wrigley is one of the few MPs who understands the threat of big tech. Earlier this year told us about the growing influence of AI firm Palantir across the British state, from the NHS and the Ministry of Defence to the Cabinet Office. Starting with an off-the-books meeting between Boris Johnson, Dominic Cummings, and Palantir co-founder Peter Thiel, Wrigley argues that the US tech giant has steadily embedded itself at the heart of government while remaining largely unscrutinised. Wrigley questions whether parliament even understands what Palantir's systems are doing. From data collection and technical lock-in to lobbying and corporate influence, he asks whether Britain's increasing dependence on a single American company might leave the country vulnerable.

programme.title: Alex Horne vs FootballJOE Quiz
programme.desc: Taskmaster and comedy legend Alex Horne takes on a quiz testing his knowledge of comedians, football, hams, chickens and more, filmed at the Chesham United clubhouse. Alex is promoting his annual Comedy Football Trophy match taking place at Chesham United, featuring some of the biggest names in comedy playing for a great cause.

programme.title: Kneecap Interview
programme.desc: Kneecap joined PoliticsJOE following the dismissal of their terror case against member Mo Chara in the British courts. The band discussed the legal proceedings, which centred on allegations that Chara displayed a Hezbollah flag during a London concert in November 2024. UK prosecutors had argued this could constitute an offence under the Terrorism Act, but the case was thrown out due to procedural failures.

programme.title: Monkey Mayhem

programme.title: Spots and Stripes
programme.desc: Whether spots or stripes, markings can be used for anything from communication to cooling. What look like standout fashion statements to us can help animals vanish completely into a landscape. The design possibilities are endless, and vary to suit the terrain and geography. Whatever their remarkable uses, spots and stripes adorn some of the most iconic animals in the natural world. Camouflage or decoration, we can thank both spots and stripes for handing these creatures their unique and majestic beauty.

programme.title: Hot Roads
programme.sub-title: The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads - S2 E01
programme.desc: The Carretera de la muerte - the road to death- is one of the most dangerous roads in the world. Year after year many people die here. programme.title: glCuba
programme.desc: Even anyone who has not yet been to Cuba can conjure up certain images of American vintage street cruisers, imposing buildings that have seen better days, white sandy beaches full of palms and loving couples on the Malecón against a backdrop of crashing waves. This island is somewhat of a myth and its people generate a special joie de vivre. The legendary Hershey Train departs for Matanzas from the capital, Havana. On the oldest electrified railway line in the Caribbean, 60-year-old Spanish carriages make their way along al-most 100 kilometres of coastline in the most relaxed way possible. The Salvavidas on Varadero, probably the most famous beach on the island, have a particular-ly beautiful workplace. The lifeguards' territory ex-tends for more than 20 kilometres. In order to protect the coasts of Cuba, mangroves have been replanted here for many years. The project is supported by the UN and planting is often carried out by schoolchildren. In doing so, Cuban children learn how to treat their maritime habitat in a sustainable fashion. The former colonial city of Trinidad on Cuba's south coast is gen-erally considered to be one of the most beautiful places in the entire Caribbean. The houses here are particular-ly colourful. A plethora of magnificent buildings can be seen at the Plaza Mayor, the neo-baroque main square.

programme.title: Caribbean sisters: The Lesser Antilles St. Kitts & Nevis
programme.desc: In the centre of the Caribbean, volcanoes rise steeply from the sea, thus shaping the sister islands of St. Kitts & Nevis. Their slopes, covered in lush rainforests, snow-white, sandy beaches and the surrounding tur-quoise tinted waters provide the ultimate setting for this record-breaking, albeit tiny island paradise: Both islets are the smallest of the Caribbean dwarf states and also rank among the world's ten smallest states. A hot pepper sauce, made of a creative mixture of ginger, garlic, thyme and extraordinarily hot chillies that thrive in the hot and humid climate of Nevis, is simmering on the stove of Violet and Llewellyn's house. Lemmy Pemberton digs up abandoned turtle nests with his bare hands, as he wants to be certain that all of the babies have indeed managed to make it. Members of the Turtle Group catch sea turtles in order to take their measurements and fit them with transmitters. Taxi bus-es are not only the main means of transport on St. Kitts & Nevis, they are also an artistic expression of each driver's personality. Colourfully embellished, each taxi represents island art on wheels.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Yosemite National Park is a place of superlatives: with towering cliffs and giant sequoias, home to coyotes, black bears and the most elusive of all: the bobcat. Watch this documentary with ist spectacular shots, aerial views and time-lapse shots and learn some new facts about the biodiversity in one of North Americas most spectacular National Parks.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Gates of the Arctic National Park and Preserve is an American national park that protects portions of the Brooks Range in northern Alaska. The park is the northernmost national park in the United States, situated entirely north of the Arctic Circle. The park is the second largest in the US, slightly larger in area than Belgium. Gates of the Arctic was initially designated as a national monument on December 1, 1978, before being redesignated as a national park and preserve upon passage of the Alaska National Interest Lands Conservation Act in 1980. A large part of the park has additional protection as the Gates of the Arctic Wilderness that adjoins the Noatak Wilderness. They form the largest contiguous wilderness in the United States together. Fauna include brown bears, black bears, muskoxen, moose, Dall sheep, timber wolves, wolverines, coyotes, lynxes, marmots, porcupines, river otters, red and Arctic fox species, beavers, snowshoe hares, muskrats, bald eagles, golden eagles, peregrine falcons, ospreys, great horned and northern hawk-owls. More than half a million caribou, including the Central Arctic, Western Arctic, Teshekpuk, and Porcupine herds, migrate through the central Brooks Range twice yearly, traveling north in summer, and south in winter. Caribou are important as a food source to native peoples. The park is the northernmost range limit for the Dall sheep. About 132 brown bears reside in the park and preserve, based on a density of about one bear per 100 square miles.

programme.title: mareTV: Wismar Bay
programme.desc: The Wismar Bay is unique in its diversity on the Mecklenburg Baltic Sea coast: cliffs, sandy beaches, salt marshes, enchanted islands and, last but not least, the proud Hanseatic city of Wismar with its brick Gothic buildings, which are a UNESCO World Heritage Site. When the mighty logs get wedged together in the timber mill in the port of Wismar, Steven Buchholz has to get to work with his chainsaw. It's a dangerous job, because the logs weigh tons. As a trained carpenter, Steven is a virtuoso with the chain saw. Even after his shift is over, he is looking for the thrill: the wind off his home island of Poel is favorable that day and he wants to reclaim the German record in the kite surfing high jump. For a long time, Ramona Stelzer only knew fish as a tasty ingredient between two halves of a bun. But when the goldsmith got her hands on fish leather, her business idea was born: she processes the unique natural product fish skin into fine jewelry. The problem is that hardly anyone in Germany tans fish skin. In order to reliably obtain supplies, Ramona now wants to learn this craft herself.

programme.title: Dust And Stripes
programme.desc: In a never-ending quest for grass and water, the striped herds undertake an annual epic trek across the vast lunar landscape of the Kalahari's Makgadikgadi Pans. Most of the year, the Makgadikgadi is an inhospitable wasteland of windswept, salt-encrusted pans. For the area's water-dependent zebra, the Boteti River on the western edge of the pans is a dry-season lifeline. However, it is also a death trap, with lions waiting in ambush and crocodiles lurking in dark riverside caves.

programme.title: Coasts
programme.desc: A cat shark out hunting, guillemots fearlessly jumping from the cliffs of Helgoland, the birth of a snow-white baby seal: the 2,400km of German coastlines are home to a unique diversity of species. Over thousands of years, the slow current of the North Sea has allowed silt to accumulate and form the unique world of the Wadden Sea, a UNESCO World Heritage Site since 2009. Nowhere else in the world does such a landscape exist that, thanks to the tides, is in a constant state of change. On the Baltic Sea, it's above all the Bodden that are unique. They form a chain of shallow bodies of water connected to the sea by narrow channels. Here in the brackish water, only specialists can survive. The North Sea coast is famed for its extensive mud flats, the Halligen islands which are often submerged in winter and endless sandy beaches and dykes. Seals sun themselves on sandbanks and regenerate after the rigours of hunting. Plum in the middle of the North Sea, the cliffs of Helgoland are a paradise for seabirds like gannets, black-legged kittiwakes and guillemots. For the grey seals, the mating season begins in winter and with it fearsome battles between rival males. The largest bulls weigh in at 300kg and are the biggest mammals in Germany. Hunted mercilessly by fishermen competing for the same fish, for many years the seals had disappeared from Germany's coasts. Now they're under protection and are slowly returning. North and Baltic Seas have retained their original character. The Baltic has Darss, Rügen and Usedom, three of the most beautiful holiday destinations in the country and with the whitest beaches. In autumn, red deer stags stamp majestically along the sand against the foamy backdrop of the Baltic. Peregrine falcons, too, have made coast and islands their home.

programme.desc: The BP Ultimate Rally-Raid joined the W2RC calendar in 2024. The competition on Portuguese and Spanish tracks is always unforgettable for both cars and motorcycles. The event, organized by the Automóvel Club de Portugal, counts as the second round of the calendar. The rally offers a 1,200-kilometer route with wide and varied tracks: from the vast sandy beaches of the Alentejo coast to the busy roads of the Ribatejo region, not forgetting the rocky tracks of the Extremadura province in Spain. Diversity is the key word for the five days of racing! The bivouac is set up in the heart of the town of Grândola, in the province of Setúbal, 100 kilometers south of Lisbon.

programme.title: Ninjaball Run
programme.desc: When the ninja learn that Darreth's Mojo Dojo is to be destroyed and Darreth doesn't have the money to save it, our heroes enter the annual NinjaBall Run to win its cash prize in order to save the dojo. As Lloyd continues to train and unlock his hidden powers, the Ninja learn land developers are going to destroy Darreth's Mojo Dojo unless Darreth can find the money to save it. The Ninja decide to enter their Ninja Tank into the annual NinjaBall Run cross-country rally to try to win its cash prize. Revisiting past characters who also enter the race, the high-speed derby will only grow more dangerous as Garmadon enters his Black Bounty, realizing this is the perfect chance to use his Mega-Weapon and rid the ninja. In the end, the Ninja will discover a few secrets within their Ninja Tank, allowing them to beat Garmadon's Bounty by a millisecond and saving Darreth's Dojo with their well-deserved cash prize. And as a final surprise, the Ninja steal back the Destiny's Bounty and make it their own once again.

programme.title: Child's Play
programme.desc: When the Ninja interrupt Lord Garmadon from using his Mega-Weapon to ‘turn back the clock' and bring to life the fossils of a monster, the Ninja are accidentally hit and turned into kids and are now forced to enlist Lloyd's help to battle the awakened monster. Tired of intense training, Lloyd yearns to play and enjoy his youth. The Ninja remind Lloyd that along with great power, comes great responsibility. When the Ninja interrupt Lord Garmadon from using his Mega-Weapon to ‘turn back the clock' and bring to life the fossils of a monster, the Ninja are accidentally hit and soon discover they've been turned into kids! Seeking Lloyd's help and relying on childhood antics, the five ninja kids must destroy the reawakened monster that's hunting them in the city. In the end, Lloyd makes the difficult decision and sacrifices his youth in order to save them from the beast, turning forward the clock and turning Lloyd into a young man. Sensei Wu fears now that since Lloyd is young man, the final battle of good versus evil approaches sooner than he had ever expected.

programme.title: The Surge
programme.desc: After a time of peace, the Ninja are called back into action. The spirit of the defeated Overlord has infected the electric grid of Ninjago and is using all available technology to exact his revenge on Lloyd. Nowhere is safe but fortunately, the Ninja have been given the powerful Techno Blades. But the only problem is that they have no idea how to use them. Time has passed since the Ultimate Battle, and while the Golden Ninja continues to watch over Ninjago, the other Ninja have become complacent as schoolteachers. When a mysterious invitation from genius Cyrus Borg brings them to the futuristic New Ninjago City, trouble surges when a digital virus of the Overlord takes over technology. The Golden Ninja makes a heroic entrance, only to find out his Golden Power supercharges the enemy. Sensei Wu stays behind so that the Ninja can escape with the only thing that can save Ninjago's future – Borg's Techno Weapons.

programme.title: The Art Of The Silent Fist
programme.desc: The Ninja go into hiding but an army of the Digtial Overlord's evil robotic Nindroids are hunting them wherever they go. Their only chance is to learn the secrets of the Techno blades and use them to cut all power to save Ninjao from this technological menace. The Ninja hide out at a safe place void of technology – Sensei Garmadon's Sanctuary. That night, Zane is visited by Borg's female robo-assistant, Pixal. She warns them that the Digital Overlord is after Lloyd's Golden Power in order to become flesh, but the Techno Blades can reboot the system and erase him for good. After a highly advanced army of Nindroids attacks the Sanctuary, Lloyd flees with his father into the wilderness of Ninjago, while the rest set off on a quest to turn off all power in Ninjago, so that they can erase the Digital Overlord once and for all.

programme.title: The Book Of Total Badness
programme.desc: The NEXO-Knights must fight Jestro's Monsters of Destruction which are attacking all over the Kingdom. But Merlok smells a trap…is he right? In a dark, destroyed part of the kingdom, Jestro arrives at the ruins of a HUGE castle. The Book of Monsters knows this place: the great evil wizard Monstrux lived here. The Book sniffs out some powerful magic in the ruins: “The Book of Destruction.” With this, The Book tells Jestro they can destroy the NEXO-Knights and then attack the King's Castle and cause massive destruction. Jestro creates destructive monsters and sends them all over the realm, so the Knights must separate and fight single combats all over the place. The Knights lose these battles (lesson: they have to work as a team!) And, just when the Knights are scattered across the Kingdom, Jestro attacks the King's Castle! It looks like all is lost. When Aaron, who has escaped, returns to see Jestro's attack, he realizes he must gather his fellow Knights. Merlok says it's very dangerous, but Aaron says he must take the risk to gather the Knights and save Knighton.

programme.title: The Might And The Magic
programme.desc: Aaron races across the kingdom to gather the NEXO-Knights as Jestro and his Destructive Monsters attack the King's Castle. The Knights must get back to the capitol in time, or Jestro will rule the kingdom! Jestro, while still attacking the King's Castle, has second thoughts until the Book of Monsters orders the mad jester to feed him another magic book he's found (and has been saving.) It's the powerful “Book of Revenge!” Now, combining the powers of Revenge and Destruction, Jestro and his monsters will get their vengeance on King Halbert and the Kingdom of Knighton. Jestro and his monsters lay siege…will they destroy the castle?! Meanwhile, Aaron races across the Kingdom gathering the NEXO-Knights one at a time. As each Knight rejoins the group, they become a more and more powerful team. They even get Robin to join them as the Black Knight in his repaired power suit. Our Knights arrive, finally regrouped, fight off Jestro, save the castle and the King. It's a glorious victory! The King is so pleased after seeing how the brave NEXO-Knights saved his kingdom, he allows Macy to join them as an official NEXO-Knight.

programme.title: Back To School
programme.desc: When the NEXO-Knights are sloppy in a fight with Jestro, Merlok 2.0 sends them back to the Knights' Academy. Not only for a brush-up but to find out what Jestro is after in its hallowed halls. As they Knights battle Jestro – in a somewhat haphazard and lazy way – they discuss the fact that Jestro never wins and that they're always getting over on him. Despite defeating the jerky Jester and his evil Book, Merlok 2.0 discovers that something about the attack on the village is tied to the Knights' Academy. It looks like that's where they'll strike next. It wouldn't hurt for the Knights to go “back to school” to watch for Jestro and for some refresher training. Merlok is sure Jestro wants something at the Academy, but he doesn't know what it is. The Knights are very much “fish out of water” at the academy, even with the “cool kids” – Robin and Ava – showing them around. The next generation of Knights is being taught to integrate the NEXO-Magic of Merlok into their fighting techniques and these kids are good (so good, they initially kick the lazy, know-it-all Knight's butts!) Their old principal, the ever-ornery Headmaster Brickland, sets them straight: they're all still slackers, and they better get their acts together (especially Lance!) The Knights take shifts as “library helpers” much to the delight of the old squirebot librarian, MARGE. They're convinced Jestro is after a book…isn't he always after a book? When Jestro attacks, the Knights help organize the students and there's a big fight in the Academy Library versus Jestro and his Monsters. They drive Jestro off without letting him steal any books! Victory! But as Jestro leaves, we see him holding what the Book of Monsters really wanted: a snow globe with a castle in it that was sitting on the librarian's desk. In the Lava Lands, Jestro throws the snow globe into a volcano and it frees the massive Castle of Monstrux from its snowy magic prison

programme.title: Greed Is Good?
programme.desc: When Jestro uses the Book of Greed to rob Auremville of its riches, he also gets Lance's parents as prisoners and these demanding rich folks are too much for even monsters to handle. Jestro's not sure what to do with his new castle in the Lava Lands. “Every castle needs a big chamber filled with treasure” says the Book of Monsters so they've got to go out looting! The BOM convinces Jestro to call forth GENERAL MAGMAR, and Jestro appoints him as “general manager” of “castle operations,” much to Magmar's dismay. Meanwhile, Jestro and the BOM find the BOOK OF GREED. This will allow them to make greedy, rapacious monsters that will bring them all the treasure they want to fill their castle! They'll head to the richest town in the realm – AUREMVILLE! Meanwhile, in Auremville, the NEXO-Knights arrive for a huge “Gold is Good” ball at Lance's house. When the Monsters finally arrive in Auremville, a battle breaks out and the greedy monsters make off with everything…including Lance's parents, Goldie and Cuthbert Richmond who are clad in the finest golden garments and so look valuable! Lance will now be forced to live…poor. The Knights have to get his parents back. Meanwhile, his parents – Cuthbert and Goldie Richmond –think their imprisonment in Jestro's gold-filled castle is a “spa holiday” with the worst service. They order Magmar and the monsters around like servants and drive them all crazy. The Knights pile into the Fortrex and head for the Lava Lands, formulating a plan along the way to free Lance's parents. In a village half-way to Jestro's Castle, the Knights run into…Jestro and his monsters headed the other way with Lance's parents and all the gold they've stolen. There's a big fight, until they realize they might have the same goal and decide to deal. The BOM wants to give them back all the gold and Lance's parents. Lance says “No deal.” “We'll take the gold, you can keep my parents.” It's a weird and comical stand-off. Finally, Clay convinces Lance he has to take his parents back even if they don't always get along (and, it's the only way to get the gold back.)

programme.title: The Jade Princess
programme.desc: In the wake of an assassination attempt targeting the royal family, the ninja invite the royal princess, HARUMI, into their makeshift family. Lloyd glimpses someone escaping over the rooftops with a sack on their back. Fearing it is the kidnapped princess, Lloyd takes up the chase! He discovers to his surprise, however, that the masked intruder is none other than the princess herself, who is not quite as docile or meek as she pretends. She has a habit of sneaking out of her chambers at night to feed the homeless who surround the Imperial Palace. This revelation only endears her to Lloyd more and Harumi and Lloyd quickly strike up a friendship. Unfortunately, trouble catches up to the ninja when the Sons Of Garmadon target the second Oni mask and attack the palace. The scope of the attack proves more than the Ninja were prepared for as the Sons of Garmadon detonate a series of subterranean bombs, bringing down part of the palace. Lloyd and Harumi escape onto the flying ship, DESTINY'S BOUNTY. But the victory is a pyrrhic one. The second Oni Mask has been stolen and Harumi's parents and Master Hutchins are feared lost.

programme.title: The Pranks
programme.desc: Stephanie finds the perfect front page story for the school paper! It's almost too good to be true. Emma and Andrea go undercover to solve the mystery of the two Jacobs.The friends are using their talents to pull a prank on Olivia. But who gets the last laugh?

programme.title: Andrea's Big Moment
programme.desc: When famous pop star Livi comes to Heartlake City to judge a talent show, our five friends Olivia, Mia, Andrea, Emma and Stephanie all decide to enter – and one of them, in particular, really wants to win but faces some serious challenge from an old rival. A talent show has come to Heartlake City and all the girls enter the talent competition hoping to impress the judges, especially their idol, pop star Chloe. No one wants a shot at stardom more than Andrea, which is why the other girls are surprised when she doesn't show up to practice before the first round of the competition. Very nearly eliminated prior to the big show, Andrea panics and throws herself into an intense practice-training mode, even shutting her friends out when they're trying to help her with her performance. Just moments before her live TV debut, Andrea realizes she's missing a key element to her act. Can she pull it off without her friends? And are the other girls willing to help after being pushed away?

programme.title: Kate's Island
programme.desc: The five friends leave for science camp that takes place on an island and during the trip, they meet the stand-offish Kate – but they soon realize that there's more to her than meets the eyes and that you shouldn't judge the book by its cover. No one is more excited than Olivia about science camp at a beautiful rocky offshore island with a lighthouse. But Olivia quickly gets off on the wrong foot with a mysterious girl named Kate who seems obsessed with a medallion necklace and the island's rumored history of pirates and treasure. Even worse for Olivia, Kate seems to be growing extra chummy with Mia, even sneaking around the island with her late at night. With the help of Stephanie, Emma and Andrea, Olivia is determined to get to the bottom of the girls' secret friendship and find out once and for all what they're searching for on the island, but they better not let Mrs. Stevens catch them out of their cabin past curfew.

programme.title: The Grand Hotel
programme.desc: The five friends help out at The Grand Hotel that Andrea's family just bought during what was supposed to be a quiet weekend until a hotel critic arrives unexpectedly. The girls are ready to do everything to make a great impression – but things don't quite go according to plan. Andrea, Stephanie, Olivia, Emma and Mia have come for breakfast at the fanciest hotel in town, now owned by Andrea's family. When Andrea's aunt has to leave town, the girls volunteer to run the hotel for the weekend with the help of quirky Grandma Jean. This is the perfect job for Stephanie's expert managerial skills but then the hotel suddenly fills to capacity with guests, including a hotel critic that can make or break the hotel's reputation! Now the girls find themselves in over their heads juggling reception, childcare, food prep and waitressing, a dog-walking service and a testy chef who quits on them in the middle of dinner. Unfortunately, much of this is their own fault. Can the girls save the Grand Hotel from themselves?

programme.desc: The Bear's good friend, the Tiger, is back for a visit and they decide to spend the time together in an intellectual way – playing chess. programme.title: Masha's Spooky Stories
programme.sub-title: Terrifying True Story About Monsters And Those Who Fear Them
programme.desc: Are you afraid of monsters? Sure you are! Let me tell you a scary story about a boy who experienced a real fear…This story happened on an abandoned tractor factory. The boy lost a scoop from his toy-tractor and decided to look for it at the factory. So he goes up the stairs and sees a large female monster, who was about to paint her lips with a roller! As he kept walking he noticed more monsters playing domino! The boy was very terrified and about to cry, when he learnt that it was just a movie set and all the monsters were not real! They were just actors…Finally the boy realized that all the monsters from the books and movies are not real at all! But if want to see a real monster- watch a fly under a microscope!

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it's her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf's tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf's tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.sub-title: The Wolf and the Seven Young Kids
programme.desc: This educative tale teaches us that caution should never be dismissed. Mother-Goat goes to pick up cabbage, leaving her seven kids alone at home. Hungry Wolf tries to get into the house imitating mother Goat's voice to fool the little yeanlings. He manages to deceive six kids, but the seventh, the smallest one, manages to hide in the oven. The Wolf tries to get into the house through the chimney, but here comes Mother-Goat and finds her seventh kid. She melts the stove, and the Wolf rushes into the forest with his tail burnt. The other six kids come back home and finally the family reunites.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.sub-title: The Fox and the Rolling Pin
programme.desc: This is the story about the Fox, the Cat and the Rooster. The sneaky Fox wanted to fool the Cat in order to eat the Rooster and get a rolling-pin. No matter how the Fox tried to butter up the Cat, he denied hand over the Rooster to the Fox. To teach her a lesson, the Cat got into a bag himself and when the Fox opened it in order to eat the Rooster, the Cat jumped out of it and frightened her. The point of the story is that “if you are well off you don't seek better”.

programme.title: Masha's Tales

The Tsar decided to send Yegor over distant seas to bring do not know what. Despite Tsar's insidious plan, Yegor has successfully returned back home and even taught the king an important lesson not to envy other people.

programme.title: From concept vehicle to full-production ID. Buzz
programme.sub-title: How was the electric Microbus created
programme.desc: The new model line's assistance systems perfect ease of driving and safety. Included as standard in the ID. Buzz and ID. Buzz Cargo is the ‘Car2X' local warning system, which utilises signals from other vehicles and the transport infrastructure to spot hazards in real time. Also included as standard: the ‘Front Assist' emergency braking function and, in the MPV, the ‘Lane Assist' lane-keeping assistant. With new software, new assistance functions are also making their way into the ID. family. Available as an option is ‘Travel Assist with swarm data', which facilitates partially automated driving across the entire speed range and, for the first time, assisted lane-changing on the motorway. Also new: the ‘Memory Function' for automated parking on a previously saved route.

programme.title: New 2023 Range Rover Sport Design Reveal Film
programme.desc: The New Range Rover Sport has made its global premiere with a dramatic world-first climb up a flooded dam spillway in Iceland. The epic ascent saw New Range Rover Sport resist the surging torrent of water flowing down the ramp of the Karahnjukar Dam – the biggest of its kind in the world – at a rate of 750 tonnes per minute. A loss of traction risked plunging down the perilous 90m drop at the base of the spillway to the valley floor below. The successful spillway ascent was screened for the first time at an exclusive launch event at Jaguar Land Rover's Advanced Product Creation Centre at Gaydon, UK. Official James Bond stunt driver Jessica Hawkins was behind the wheel as the New Range Rover Sport demonstrated its grip, traction, performance and composure, completing the latest in a series of challenges for Land Rover's luxury performance SUV. Previous feats include a record-setting hill-climb at Pikes Peak, a first recorded crossing of the ‘Empty Quarter' desert in the Arabian Peninsula and a first ascent of the 999 steps to Heaven's Gate in China, in 2018.

programme.title: Hispano Suiza showcases its history in the Peralada Castle Museum
programme.desc: The history of Hispano Suiza is showcased, for the very first time, in the Peralada Castle Museum (Girona, Spain) where visitors will be able to contemplate the past and present of the legendary car brand founded in 1904 by Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt. The Hispano Suiza Room will close the usual tour of the Peralada Castle Museum. After years of researching to gather the largest number of pieces and objects related to its history, Hispano Suiza becomes part of this important collection. The Hispano Suiza exhibition encompasses a journey through various decades: from the beginning of the 20th century, when Hispano Suiza was founded, to the present day. After passing through a luxurious hall, the public will be able to visit a recreation of the offices of Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt, where countless business and technical ideas, emerged and took shape, turning Hispano Suiza into a point of reference, for luxury, comfort and technical solutions. In this area, the original painting 'Dame with a mink' by Ramon Casas takes pride of place: it was used as an illustration on the company's original shares.

programme.title: TechDay Digital Light
programme.desc: Safety and customer satisfaction come first at Audi. They are part and parcel of the success of the company with the four rings. In that context, light technology is steadily growing more important and creating a wider range of possibilities and perspectives, from added safety for the driver, to external communication and individualization. Systematic light digitization is making all of this possible. It is particularly visible in the new Audi A8: the forward-looking Digital Matrix LED headlights and digital OLED rear lights raise the customer experience to a whole new level: for the first time in any Audi model, light is completely digitized. The car can be individualized even further through its digital OLED rear lights. The Digital Matrix LED headlights also include three new functions: advanced traffic information, a lane light with direction indicator lights on highways, and an orientation light on country roads. These features not only demonstrate Audi's “Vorsprung durch Technik,” they also add value.

programme.title: Mercedes-Benz DRIVE PILOT Sensors S-Class
programme.desc: The exact location of a Mercedes equipped with DRIVE PILOT is determined using a high-precision positioning system that is much more powerful than conventional GPS systems. In addition to the anonymised data collected by LiDAR, camera, radar and ultrasound sensors, a digital HD map provides a three-dimensional image of the road and the surroundings with information on road geometry, route characteristics, traffic signs and special traffic events (e.g. accidents or road works). This high-precision map differs from maps for navigation devices by, among other things, its higher accuracy in the centimetre rather than metre range and its detailed junction and route model. The map data is stored in backend data centres and updated constantly. Each vehicle also stores an image of this map information on board, constantly compares it with the backend data and updates the local dataset as required. All of this enables stable and accurate positioning through a representation of the surroundings that is independent of factors such as shadows or dirty sensors.

programme.title: Kia Sportage Exterior Design in Lunar Silver
programme.desc: A number of new technologies optimize the precision and control of the chassis in a wide variety of weather and road conditions. The standard electronic damper control (Electronic Control Suspension, ECS) in the GT-line version increases comfort and safety thanks to the continuous damping control. The system reacts to body movements and steering inputs and changes the damping behavior at lightning speed in order to counteract the vehicle's diving, pitching and rolling movements when cornering. It also adjusts the damping force in the case of obstacles in order to cope with them as comfortably as possible and to reduce the influence of post-vibrations on the wheels. A premiere for the Sportage is the “All-Terrain-Mode”, which will be available for the plug-in hybrid version with all-wheel drive. The system offers intelligent support when driving off-road or on snow by automatically optimizing the vehicle settings depending on the selected mode and thus helping the SUV to achieve maximum traction on muddy, sandy or snowy surfaces.

programme.desc: The new GLC is immediately recognisable as a member of the Mercedes-Benz SUV family. Standard equipment includes the AVANTGARDE exterior with Chrome package including chrome window surrounds and a new, chrome-look simulated underguard. One of the defining design highlights of the GLC is the redesigned front end, with headlamps that connect directly to the radiator grille to emphasise the vehicle's width, and the new radiator grille as part of the standard AVANTGARDE exterior, which now has a chrome surround and a sporty louvre in matt grey with chrome trim. The AMG Line has a radiator grille with Mercedes-Benz pattern. The body design is characterised by a full, spanned surface design enriched with precisely shaped edges in the sides. These emphasise the proportions, accentuate the muscular wheel arches and create a balance between elegance and off-road performance. Wheel arch liners in the vehicle colour are available from the AMG Line upwards for the first time. These accentuate the sportiness of the AMG Line, as optional equipment in conjunction with mixed tyres. Also available as an optional extra are easy-entry running boards and, from the AMG Line upwards, a Night package.

programme.title: Colour change with the power of thought
programme.sub-title: The BMW iX Flow meets neuro-technology
programme.desc: The Munich-based startup brainboost used the new and improved colour-changing effect in a one-off collaboration with the BMW Group at rad°hub aimed at raising awareness of mental health. With the help of brainboost, the BMW iX Flow was connected directly to the brain of the rad°hub delegates using an electroencephalograph (EEG), which records the brain's electrical activity. “The colour patterns of the BMW iX Flow react to brain activity and reflect the level of activity,” explains brainboost CEO Philipp Heiler. “Once the brain is at rest, the changes of patterns on the iX Flow also become calmer and more rhythmical.” A special animation was activated if delegates managed to maintain this state for several seconds. Thus, the participants were able to gradually calm and relax their brains under the guidance of the brainboost experts and with the help of neurofeedback via the iX Flow. This matures the knowledge of which strategies work best to specifically shut down one's own brain activity for relaxation, e.g. in everyday working life.
